scenes.text: Your AI agent nailed the demo. Will it nail the next eight?
Most leaderboards measure whether it gets it right once. But in a business, what matters is something else: getting it right every time.
Do the math: an agent that's right 90% of the time, if it has to be right eight times in a row, drops to 43%.
And this isn't theory. On tau-bench, a customer service test, the best agents of 2024 succeeded less than 50% of the time… and eight times in a row, less than 25%.
Why? Because an agent doesn't answer a question: it walks a path of many steps. A single error brings it all down.
So before you buy an agent, don't ask how often it's right. Ask how many times in a row it's right… and what happens when it fails.
Because a demo is once. Production is always.
Save it, and share it with someone who's about to buy an agent.
